description: Traffic Volumes - Provincial Highway System is a dataset listed in Province of Nova Scotia open data portal (data.novascotia.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Province of Nova Scotia. Traffic volume census on Provincial Highway System. Coverage: Nova Scotia. The portal files it under the category Roads, Driving and Transport. Its tags are traffic volume census, traffic volumes, traffic. The table has 16 columns. The portal shows 2026-06-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Nova Scotia Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-novascotia-ca-portal.
